70ecbc4ae48f: CalendarAnything is a long-established app for viewing Salesforce records on calendars. MultiDatePick is a calendar for picking dates, booking time and saving records. Here is where each one is stronger.
33b5cbc7c903: If you search for a Salesforce calendar app, CalendarAnything comes up early. It has been on the AppExchange for years, and it is good at what it was built for: putting many kinds of Salesforce records on shared calendars that teams browse, filter and print. MultiDatePick starts from the other end: the moment someone picks dates or books a time, and the records that come out of it.
ec79289c6c8e: Both are native, both work with standard and custom objects, and both are configured without code. The difference is the job. <t1>Read on for a side-by-side, and an honest list of where CalendarAnything is the better pick.</t1>
